summary: Eureka Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting its extension of the deadline to complete a business combination from May 3, 2026 to June 3, 2026. A $150,000 monthly extension fee was deposited into the trust account by Marine Thinking Inc., the target under an October 2025 BCA. The company issued a non-interest-bearing promissory note to Marine Thinking for this amount, due upon deal close or term expiry. This reflects ongoing SPAC activity; watch for potential shareholder redemptions or deal closing risk.
